question: If sqrt {3} sin theta - cos theta = 0 (theta is an acute angle), then the value of cos³theta - sqrt 3 sin³ theta will be:
solution:
**Given:**

√ {3} sin θ - cos θ = 0 (θ is an acute angle)

**Calculation:**

√ {3} sin θ - cos θ = 0 

⇒√3 sinθ = cosθ 

⇒ sinθ/cosθ = 1/√3

⇒ tan θ = tan 30° 

⇒θ = 30° 

cos³theta - √ 3 sin³ theta

⇒ (√3/2)³ - √3 × (1/2)3 ∵ [cos 30° = √3/2, sin 30° = 1/2] 

⇒ 3√3/8 - √3 × 1/8

⇒ 3√3/8 - √3/8 

⇒√3(3 - 1)/8

⇒ 2√3/8 

⇒√3/4 

**∴ The required value is √3/4.**
